methodology.distractors: Deterministically generated, nested corpus variants; core story and questions fixed across scales.
methodology.query_vectors: Real model vectors cached by model+content hash and reused across scales/budgets. Cached query vectors exclude remote query-embedding time. runtime_ms includes request pacing and local retrieval; network.ms measures HTTP time only.
methodology.decision_scope: Only largest world, 20-result budget. Production runtime reranks at most 20 candidates; larger-budget comparisons use lexical/hybrid only.
methodology.entity_scope: Default production candidate discovery: first 20 Entities ordered by id, using only name/metadata known at the query session. Fixture-specified oracle candidates are not passed to the model.
methodology.path_score: Stored directed path-node evidence coverage, not a structured path answer or causal QA accuracy.
methodology.corpus_size: Characters/bytes are measured, not estimated tokenizer tokens; summed Memory/Evidence/name text can repeat source facts.
